description: Calculate Polish contract and tax net income comparison for a company budget or UoP gross across UoP (employment), Umowa Zlecenie (mandate), Umowa o Dzieło (work contract), B2B (progressive, linear 19%, lump-sum/ryczałt), and Spółka z o.o. (board member resolution).

budget.description: Total monthly company employer budget in PLN (e.g. 15000).

costs.description: Monthly business operating costs in PLN for B2B.

grossUop.description: Gross employment contract salary if inputMode is uop_gross.

inputMode.description: Input mode: budget (total employer cost) or uop_gross (gross employment contract).

llcCosts.description: Monthly accounting and operating costs in PLN for Spółka z o.o. (default 600 PLN).

lumpRate.description: B2B lump sum tax rate percentage if taxation is lump (e.g. 12, 15, 8.5).

studentUnder26.description: Whether the mandate contractor is a student under 26 (exempt from ZUS and PIT up to limit).

taxation.description: B2B taxation type: progressive, linear, or lump.

uopUnder26.description: Whether the employment (UoP) employee is under 26 (exempt from PIT up to limit).

zus.description: B2B ZUS type: standard, preferential, or start.

name: calculate_polish_income_comparison
title: Compare Polish Net Income by Contract Type
